results.title: Película Cero
results.overview: Before leaving adolescence behind, a group of students split into fictional characters to film their transition into adulthood. Between cameras, confidences, and a shared journey to the mountains, the film captures the tremor of an ending and the glimpse of another beginning.

results.title: Rundfunk: Schau
results.overview: Registration of the theatre program by the Dutch comedy duo Rundfunk.

results.title: Quiet Life
results.overview: A refugee family in Sweden faces trauma after their youngest daughter falls into an unexplained coma when denied asylum. Parents struggle to find a cure, resilience tested amid difficult circumstances.

results.title: Me and The Spaceman
results.overview: A grieving mother embarks on an adventure with a mysterious spaceman in order to find his rocket ship.

results.title: The Crooked Cocoon
results.overview: The film "The Crooked Cocoon" is about Sima Servati, a famous and beloved actress who hates men and constantly doubts her husband. She believes that all the misfortunes in the world are due to men, until a strange and unexpected incident turns her life upside down...

results.title: In the Flesh
results.overview: A depressed tech worker begins experimenting with AI after his girlfriend leaves him for a politician.

results.title: Winkie
results.overview: When he discovers a young orphan girl in the middle of the forest, Winkie, a violent but caring monster, decides to raise the child in his own image while protecting her from the dangers of the outside world.

results.title: Lethargy
results.overview: After receiving an anonymous threat regarding intimate photos shared on social media without her consent, the inner world of Ágatha, a lonely young woman, undergoes a profound shift and turns against her.

results.title: Fien & Teun gaan op schattenjacht
results.overview: Join Fien, Teun, Sem and all their animal friends on a real pirate adventure in their latest movie! With lots of fun - well-known and new - songs!  Nephew Sem is coming to stay with Fien and Teun on the farm and they are super excited! The three of them are going on an adventure and of course the animals are allowed to come along too. When they are just on their way, they already make a big discovery. They find an old boat with a chest full of pirate clothes and ... a treasure map! That can only mean one thing: It's time for a treasure hunt!

results.title: Crybaby
results.overview: In a utopian near future where crying has ceased to exist, an emotional young woman — the only person who can still shed tears — teams up with her protective older sister on a journey into the underground world of weeping.

results.title: Nine-Ring Golden Dagger
results.overview: During the Northern Expedition of Yongxi in the early Song Dynasty, General Yang Ye heroically sacrificed himself, and his posthumous reward, the Nine-Ring Golden Dagger, fell into Liao territory. A decade later, his daughters, Yang Baba and Yang Jiumei, set out to reclaim it, facing relentless dangers. On their return, they ally with Jiao Guangpu, a former soldier of Yang Ye. Together, they outwit and overcome three enemy attacks, ensuring the dagger’s safe return to Song lands.

results.title: Coco World
results.overview: A self-obsessed saleswoman working at a makeup pyramid scheme impregnates herself with an anonymous donor in the hope of closing a sale.

results.title: Super courier
results.overview: Timur is a kind-hearted courier who is always ready to help others, even at his own expense. One day, after defending a respected judge from a group of thugs, he receives an unusual offer—to become the driver for the judge’s daughter, Sabina. However, he soon realizes that his real job is to be her bodyguard, as a powerful enemy of the family is willing to do anything to take her away. When Sabina is kidnapped, Timur must cast aside his fears and become a hero to save her and uncover why she is so important to the criminals.

results.title: IUS of Time
results.overview: Luca, a young photographer, arrives in a village in Asturias to work on an artistic project. There, he stays with Xuan, an experienced cheesemaker who is marked by a past full of rumors and prejudice. Through Luca’s camera and Xuan’s craft, the two discover unexpected connections in an intimate encounter between two seemingly opposite worlds.

results.title: Paathirathri
results.overview: A strange incident during their routine night duty pulls SI Jancy and Hareesh into a dangerous investigation. As secrets unfold, they must face their fears and the choices that could define their futures.

results.title: Izvod: Witch's Swamp
results.overview: Fleeing the bustle of a big city, a young couple seeks refuge in the chilling silence of the deep woods. In this half-forgotten primeval world, nightmares blur into waking dread, and sinister tales of old come alive: chorts, rusalkas, nightwraiths, witches, and ancestral curses lurk just beneath the surface. As dreams curdle and reality unravels, something old and malevolent tightens its grip — drawing them ever deeper into the pitch-black abyss of Slavic horror. What lies behind old prejudices, and what dark secrets does the past of these places hold? Where does true evil reside — in black magic curses or in the hearts of the people around you? The first step into the swampy quagmire has already been taken, and you will never return to how things were before.
